 Blather 'Round is the fifth and final game to be revealed for The Jackbox Party Pack 7 . In this game, you write sentences to describe pop culture phenomena to your friends, but you never get quiiiiite the right words. If you did, it wouldn’t be a game! It would just be describing things.

 Gameplay [ ] 

 In Blather 'Round, players take turns trying to describe a secret prompt. However, they only have a select few words to choose from and must put them together in a way that describes their prompt to the other players.

 As players guess, the presenter can incorporate guesses into their hints as well, and the faster someone guesses, the more points the presenter and guesser will get!

 Prompt and Sentence Making [ ] 

 At the start of each round, the players pick between three choices. One is labeled "easy" and gives fewer points than the other two, and all three can be reshuffled. (If a prompt is not chosen before time runs out, the game will autopick.)

 After all prompts are selected, each player gets a choice of several Adjectives and Nouns to choose from to fill sentences like "It's a story about a BLANKY BLANK" and must give their first hint before the rounds start.

 Guessing the Words [ ] 

 A person will be chosen as the Presenter, and they must convey their word(s) using the limited words given. The previously-made first is sent out and the Presenter must give more hints by putting together more sentences to hint players into guessing their word. Presenters can even incorporate other guesses into the hints, such as "It has the same vibe as BLANK" or "It is nothing like BLANK". This continues until time runs out, or the correct answer is made,

 During round 2, the points are doubled. At the end of both rounds, the person with the most points wins.

 Blather 'Round is a party video game and one of five games featured in The Jackbox Party Pack 7 .

 Gameplay

 All players are given three prompts to choose from on their device—with the first choice being noticeably easier than the two below it—with their respective categories, those being: Thing, Person, Place and Story . The player also has the choice to re-roll their prompts for three new, different ones. Once the players have all chosen their respective prompts, they'll be tasked to create a sentence using the words given to their device, constructing it out as they go.

 When all sentences have been created, the Presentor's sentence and chosen category will show up on-screen (as well as on the player's device) and the other players will start guessing what that certain subject could be within a two-minute time limit. The Presentor will keep on delivering sentences on their device, which some may include the players' responses as their additions to their sentences.

 Once a player manages to correctly guess the subject, the guesser will earn a total of 500 points (or half if it's categorized as "Easy") and the Presenter will also earn 750 points, plus a time bonus (maxed out at double the score's number). The players who's prompts have been chosen by the Presentor will earn 100 points apiece, which will increase individually depending on how many of their own guesses have been used.

 If the time runs out and no one gets it right, however, the prompt will be shown to everyone on-screen. The others will have the option to give the Presentor a 50-point pity bonus if they thought they could've gotten the answer right.

 After all prompts have been scoured through, a current leaderboard is shown with everyone's scores. The second round will work the same as the first, but with double the points.

 After all rounds have concluded, the player with the most points will win the game.
